0022600107.text: The Houston Rockets (2-0, first in the Southwest) visit the Atlanta Hawks (2-0, first in the Southeast and first in the East) in the third game of the season for Houston. Houston's Fred VanVleet, Reed Sheppard and Steven Adams are all listed as day-to-day, with Sheppard and Adams game-time decisions, while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (out, knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (out, foot fracture). No games have been played between these teams in 2026-27, but the Rockets won the 2025-26 season series 2-0 and most recently beat the Hawks 117-95 in Houston on March 20, 2026.
